create_3d_scene_hierarchy: create a Scene3D and attach Object3D children using the parent parameter to build a hierarchy
test_object3d_parent_assignment: test setting Object3D parent after instantiation and verify scene and parent references are correct
create_drawable3d_with_object: create a Drawable3D attached to an Object3D and verify the object reference is non-cyclic
test_drawablegroup3d_iteration: test a DrawableGroup3D by adding drawables and iterating over them to verify registration
create_camera3d_and_draw: create a Camera3D with a perspective projection matrix and draw a DrawableGroup3D to render objects
